units.source_text: 次年正月初一，玉鬘尚侍的异母兄弟红梅大纳言——即昔年唱《高砂》的童子、藤中纳言——即已故髭黑太政大臣前妻所生大公子，真木柱的同胞兄来尚侍邸贺年。

en.t: On New Year's Day of the following year, Tamakazura's half brother, the Grand Counselor Kobai, once the boy who had sung Takasago and later known as To no Chujo, the eldest son born to the late Grand Minister Higekuro's former wife and the full brother of Makibashira, came to the lady's residence to offer New Year greetings.

units.source_text: 夕雾右大臣带着六位公子也来了。

en.t: Yugiri, the Minister of the Right, also came, bringing his six sons with him.

units.source_text: 夕雾的相貌以至其他一切，无不十全其美。

en.t: Yugiri was flawless in looks and in every other respect as well.

units.source_text: 六位公子也个个眉清目秀，以年龄而论，官位皆已过高。

en.t: His six sons were all handsome and refined, and for their ages their ranks were already almost too high.

units.source_text: 在旁人看来，这一家可谓圆满无缺了。

en.t: To outsiders, this family must have seemed complete and lacking nothing.

units.source_text: 但其中的藏人少将，虽然父母特别重视，却一直心事满腹，面带愁容。

en.t: Yet among them, the Chamberlain Lieutenant, though especially cherished by his parents, was always burdened with private worries and wore a sorrowful expression.

units.source_text: 夕雾右大臣和昔年一样，隔着帷屏与玉鬘尚侍对晤。

en.t: Yugiri, the Minister of the Right, met with Tamakazura as he had in the old days, speaking to her from behind a curtain screen.

units.source_text: 他说：“只因无甚要事，以致久疏问候。

en.t: He said, "Because I had no particular business, I have long neglected to pay my respects.

units.source_text: 上了年纪以来，除了入宫之外，他处竟懒得走动。

en.t: Since growing older, I have become reluctant to go anywhere except to court.

units.source_text: 常思前来叩访，共谈往事，而总是因循过去，未能如愿。

en.t: I have often wished to call on you and talk over old times, but I kept putting it off and never managed to do as I wished.

units.source_text: 尊处如有需要，务请随时吩咐诸小儿办理。

en.t: If there is anything you need, please command my sons at any time.

units.source_text: 小弟已叮嘱彼等：必须竭诚效劳。”

en.t: I have instructed them that they must serve you with all sincerity."

units.source_text: 玉鬘尚侍答道：“寒门运蹇，今已微不足数，乃蒙依旧照拂，更使我追念先人，难于忘怀了。”

en.t: Tamakazura replied, "My house has been unfortunate and is now hardly worth mentioning, yet you still look after us as before; it makes me remember those who are gone, and I cannot forget your kindness."

units.source_text: 接着便对他约略谈起冷泉院欲召大女公子入侍之事，说道：“家无有力之后援人，入宫反而痛苦。

en.t: Then she briefly told him that Retired Emperor Reizei wished to summon her eldest daughter into service, saying, "With no powerful patron behind our family, entering court would only bring hardship.

units.source_text: 为此犹豫不决，心甚烦恼。”

en.t: That is why I cannot decide, and my heart is deeply troubled."

units.source_text: 夕雾答道：“听说今上亦曾宣示此意，不知确否。

en.t: Yugiri answered, "I have heard that His Majesty also once expressed such a wish, though I do not know whether it is certain.

units.source_text: 冷泉院今已退位，似乎盛期已过，然而相貌绝美，盖世无双，年虽稍长，而永无老相，常是翩翩少年。

en.t: Retired Emperor Reizei has now left the throne, so his prime may seem to have passed, yet his beauty is peerless, and although he is somewhat older, he never looks aged and always seems like a graceful young man.

units.source_text: 舍下倘有容颜差可之女儿，亦极愿应召入院。

en.t: If I had a daughter at home whose looks were even passable, I would be most eager to send her to serve him.

units.source_text: 只是没有一人够得上参与花容月貌的诸宫眷之列，真乃遗憾之事。

en.t: It is truly regrettable that not one of them is fit to join the ranks of those court ladies whose beauty is compared to flowers and the moon.

units.source_text: 不过冷泉院欲召尊府大女公子之事，不知是否已得大公主的母亲弘徽殿女御允许？

en.t: But as for Retired Emperor Reizei's wish to summon your eldest daughter, has he received the permission of Princess Oigimi's mother, the Kokiden Consort?

units.source_text: 以前亦曾有人欲将女儿送入冷泉院，只因顾忌此人，终于不曾实行呢。”

en.t: In the past, someone else wished to send a daughter to Retired Emperor Reizei, but out of regard for that lady, the plan was never carried out."

units.source_text: 玉鬘说道：“弘徽殿女御也曾劝我，她说近来寂寞无聊，颇思与冷泉院同心协力地照顾我的女儿，以资消遣云云。

en.t: Tamakazura said, "The Kokiden Consort has also urged me, saying that lately she is lonely and bored, and that she would very much like to join with Retired Emperor Reizei in looking after my daughter for her own diversion.

units.source_text: 因此我要加以考虑了。”

en.t: For that reason, I mean to give the matter careful thought."
